title: Why it sucks being a defender

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a defender.
It starts when you're six. You're the tallest kid on the team. So the coach says: "Just stand at the back."
Age nine. Corner kick. You finally get to go up. The ball never comes. You jog all the way back.
Age twelve. Perfect sliding tackle. Clean ball. Nobody claps.
Age fourteen. The striker falls over your shadow. Penalty. Yellow card... for you.
Age sixteen. Ninety minutes. Not one shot on target. Clean sheet. Man of the match? The goalkeeper.
Age seventeen. The new winger is faster than a scooter. You blink... and the ball goes through your legs.
That's the thing about being a defender. When you do your job... nothing happens.
Tag your defender. Tell them you see them.
